case_title: LENY ROMERO ROGERO ET AL VS. JOSHUA TOLLIVER

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,870.00 FILED BY ROGERO, LENY ROMERO DUMO, MARIE KRISTINE ROGERO AS TO DEFENDANT TOLLIVER, JOSHUA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-28-2020 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
COPYING FEES (5 PAGE) PAID BY PLAINTIFF DUMO, MARIE KRISTINE ROGERO
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-28-2020 - CONTINUED ON COURT'S OWN MOTION TO JAN-28-2021 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. W. TRUPEK, (506)
DECLARATION OF DUE DILIGENCE IN ATTEMPTING SERVICE - FEE FOR SERVICE $0.00 - FILED BY PLAINTIFF ROGERO, LENY ROMERO DUMO, MARIE KRISTINE ROGERO AS TO DEFENDANT TOLLIVER, JOSHUA
ORDER CASE CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-28-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO MAR-03-2021 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. DISCLOSURE IS MADE. PLAINTIFFS MARIE KRISTINE ROGERO DUMO AND LENY ROMERO ROGERO ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT JOSHUA TOLLIVER IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $ 3750. A CASHIER'S CHECK IN THE AMOUNT OF $2881 WAS GIVEN TO THE DEFENDANT IN COURT LEAVING A BALANCE OF $869 TO BE PAID. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE MARCH 3RD HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PLAINTIFFS LENY ROMERO ROGERO AND MARIE KRISTINE ROGERO DUMO ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT JOSHUA TOLLIVER IS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFFS STATE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT HAS BEEN PAID. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
